selected_active_skill.name: Slash
selected_active_skill.why: Lowest ambiguity hostile active skill: no CASTING stage, no FLYING/projectile stage, no duration/expiry, no consumable ammo. Server verifies level for iNeedSkill%10==0; client still requires a weapon and >=4 MSP.

rejected_for_first_slice.103001 Flash: Type3 magic path adds cast/effect semantics and wider damage/effect surface.

selected_active_skill.client_data_owner: WS31 catalog + pinned client TBL; icon/animation/FX are client data/resources, not new wire families.

families.layout: WIZ_MYINFO contains class/level and exact 9 x u8 m_bstrSkill slice; WIZ_SKILLPT_CHANGE updates a skill bucket as type u8 + value u8.
families.owner: character state/WS03 route; WS31 client skill data
families.why_partial: The complete WIZ_MYINFO body is outside this milestone; only the 9-byte skill-array slice and 0x32 update body are frozen here.
families.slash_specific: 101003 has iNeedSkill=1010 => modulator 0, so both exact server eligibility and client basic-skill UI gate use player level >=3 rather than a specialization skill-point bucket.

client_effect_assets.note: Animation/icon/FX availability is a client-data/resource dependency, not an S2C effect packet.

npc_death: WIZ_ATTACK result=2 when lethal normal attack is reported
WIZ_DEAD target_id from AI death event
death_and_respawn.corpse: Client retains NPC in dying/dead state after WIZ_DEAD. WIZ_CORPSE is not proven as part of the mob death chain.
death_and_respawn.out: Do not require WIZ_NPC_INOUT OUT for death: exact RecvNpcDead has that call commented. OUT remains a visibility/despawn event, not the death signal.
death_and_respawn.respawn: WS25 lifecycle respawn -> WIZ_NPC_INOUT IN + detail record, reusing runtime ID under current WS25 policy.

consumer_owners.WS03: Route/gate packets by session state and bind every player-origin actor to authenticated session. For WIZ_MAGIC_PROCESS reject/overwrite mismatched source_id; for WIZ_ATTACK no source field exists.
consumer_owners.WS25: Mob runtime identity, alive/dead/respawn lifecycle and mob attack intent; no packet encoding.
consumer_owners.WS10: Real browser gate: target visible mob, normal attack, HP delta, death, respawn, Slash, MSP change, FX/result.

unknown.reason: Opcode exists and client handler exists, but exact NPC death path proven here uses WIZ_DEAD; no exact mob WIZ_CORPSE sender was found.
Exact WIZ_ATTACK result body has only result code; range/cooldown cause is semantic state in WS19, not a proven distinct field.
Only class/level context and exact 9-byte skill array slice are needed for this milestone.

required_sequence: visible/targetable monster from existing visibility authority
